## Overview

This directory contains technology-layer governance patterns for Golden Path CI/CD pipeline templates. These patterns define the structural specification, required stage composition, verification layer integration, and compliance evidence obligations for the workflow component of a Golden Path bundle.

Technology governance patterns operate as the execution layer for the Verification Contract (PTN-GOV-AI-003): every check declared in the contract has a corresponding required stage in the CI/CD pipeline template. Teams reference the template — they do not configure it.
